data.gender_notes: Yugansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yugansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the term Yuga, which refers to a cycle of time in Hindu mythology. The name Yugansh signifies the embodiment of the world cycle or the continuous flow of time. The name Yugansh carries the meaning “World Cycle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Yugansh usually hope their child will grow to embody world cycle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yugansh is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and symbolizes the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. It is believed that the name carries the power to connect the bearer to the divine and help them navigate the cycles of life.
data.etymology: Yugansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “World Cycle.”

data.cultural_impact: The name Yugansh holds deep cultural significance in Indian society, as it is associated with the concept of time cycles in Hindu mythology and philosophy. In Hindu belief, each Yuga or time cycle has its own distinct characteristics and influences on humanity. Yugansh's name corresponds to someone who is deeply connected to this cyclical understanding of time and the natural flow of the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Yugansh represents a deep understanding and connection to the cyclical nature of time and the universe. It signifies a person who is in tune with the rhythms of the cosmos and recognizes the importance of living in harmony with the cycles of birth, growth, decay, and rebirth. Yugansh is also a name that suggests a strong sense of continuity and a profound respect for the passing of time and the wisdom it brings. This name can inspire a deep sense of introspection and a dedication to learning from the past and living in the present.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yugansh: One who embodies the cycles of Yugas (ages), continuously dissolving old patterns and ushering in the new. Eternal timekeeper, embracing change and transformation.
